Each mutant removes one guarantee and must redden exactly the axes in `expect` (pairwise distinct within the spec). `red_re` anchors on the jest failure header `● <suite> › Bn @req` (ITRV §A44/§A104). `tree`/`subject` are placeholders — run the matrix on a copy with the paths substituted (§A145). Subject: PatternTranslator.translateWhere / translateBind.

PT1_later_bind_dropped._note: A BIND after the first group element no longer extends the prefix (it vanishes).

PT2_first_bind_dropped._note: A BIND as the FIRST group element is dropped (the empty group stands in).
PT2_first_bind_dropped.from: result = this.translateBind(first, { type: "bgp", triples: [] } as BGPOperation);

PT3_filters_positional._note: FILTERs are translated in place (joined as Filter(∅)) instead of group-scoped at the end. B14 is NOT in the set, by mechanism: AlgebraOptimizer.eliminateEmptyBGPInFilterJoin rewrites `Join(X, Filter(∅, e))` back to the group-level `Filter(X, e)`, so a positional FILTER that FOLLOWS the prefix is repaired by the optimizer (a second barrier); only a FILTER first in the group escapes it (Join(Filter(∅), …) under an Extend is never recursed) — B4.

PT4_iri_marker_dropped._note: BIND(<iri>) is no longer marked: it binds the IRI's string, which never joins with a stored IRI.
PT4_iri_marker_dropped.from: expression: writtenAsIri && expression.type === "literal" ? { ...expression, iri: true } : expression,
